title: The support of an effective relative cycle is closed

core_obligations: Show that the support of an effective relative r-cycle alpha on X/S with S locally Noetherian and f locally of finite type is closed in X (proof lines 1945-1977). First, for g : S' to S the inclusion of an irreducible component viewed as an integral closed subscheme, lemmas lemma-effective-functoriality (tag 0H5S) and lemma-support-family (tag 0H4V) reduce the task to showing the support of g^*alpha is closed, so assume S integral with generic point eta and prove Supp(alpha) is the closure of Supp(alpha_eta) (proof lines 1946-1952); for any s in S choose a morphism g : S' to S from the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring mapping eta' to eta and 0 to s (properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-specialization-dvr, tag 054F), reducing to proving that the support of the base change equals the closure of the support of its generic fibre (proof lines 1953-1960). Second, for S the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring with generic point eta and closed point 0: effectivity lets one write alpha_eta = sum n_i [Z_i] with all n_i positive and the Z_i integral closed of dimension r in X_eta; the specialization relation gives alpha_0 = sum n_i [Z-bar_{i,0}]_r where Z-bar_i is the closure of Z_i, and by varieties-lemma-dominate-valuation-ring-dimension-fibres (tag 0B2J) each Z-bar_{i,0} is equidimensional of dimension r; since the coefficients n_i are positive, Supp(alpha_0) is the union of the Z-bar_{i,0}, which is the fibre over 0 of the union of the Z-bar_i, which in turn is the closure of the union of the Z_i, i.e. the closure of Supp(alpha_eta) (proof lines 1962-1976). Hence Supp(alpha) is the closure of Supp(alpha_eta), in particular closed in X.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an integral base by effectivity functoriality and the support lemma for families, with the goal recast as Supp(alpha) equal to the closure of the generic support (proof lines 1946-1952).
Realize each specialization from the generic point by a valuation ring and reduce to the DVR case (proof lines 1953-1960).

DVR case: positive generic coefficients survive specialization, the closed fibres of the closures are equidimensional by the Varieties lemma, so the closed support is the fibre of the closure of the generic support (proof lines 1962-1976).
